title: A photorealistic cinematic vertical port
prompt:
A photorealistic cinematic vertical portrait of a clearly adult young woman in her early twenties, around 20 years old, standing barefoot in profile inside a modern minimalist bathroom. Her specific ethnicity or race should remain unspecified because it cannot be reliably determined from appearance alone. She has light, warm-neutral skin with natural realistic texture and soft highlights from the bathroom lighting. Her face is shown primarily in right-facing side profile, with a softly oval facial shape, a delicate jawline, a small straight nose, natural lips, gently defined eyebrows, and dark eyes directed toward the illuminated mirror in front of her. Her expression is calm, neutral, and quietly contemplative.

She has medium-length dark brown hair, smooth and straight with subtle natural volume, parted slightly off center and falling just below her shoulders. A few soft strands frame the side of her face. Her figure is slim yet distinctly curvy with a narrow waist and balanced proportions.

She wears exactly a fitted taupe-brown sleeveless midi dress made from smooth, slightly stretchy fabric, closely following the contours of her torso and hips. The dress has thin shoulder straps, a clean minimalist neckline, and a long side slit extending upward from the lower skirt along the leg. The hem falls around mid-calf. She wears no shoes and stands barefoot on the terrazzo floor, with one foot placed slightly ahead of the other. Her body is turned completely sideways toward the mirror, posture upright but relaxed, shoulders naturally lowered, one arm resting loosely beside her body while the other sits subtly behind her torso.

The bathroom is narrow and contemporary, finished almost entirely in pale gray speckled terrazzo on the walls and floor. A partially open warm wood door frames the left foreground. On the left background is a rectangular bathtub with neatly draped white towels. On the right, a white sculptural vessel sink sits on a slim black metal frame above a wooden shelf holding folded towels, toiletries, and a dark hair-styling tool with its power cord hanging downward. Above the sink is a large round mirror bordered by a warm integrated LED ring light.

Soft cool ambient daylight mixes with the warm mirror illumination, producing gentle contrast, muted shadows, and subtle reflective highlights. Shot on a full-frame camera with a 35mm lens, natural perspective, moderate depth of field, realistic skin and fabric detail, restrained cinematic color grading, cool gray terrazzo tones balanced by warm wood and taupe hues, highly realistic photography, 9:16.
